summary: Mesoblast Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 30, 2026, incorporating by reference its Appendix 4C quarterly activity report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, previously lodged with the Australian Securities Exchange. The report covers operational and financial highlights, including Ryoncil net revenues of US$36 million for the quarter and US$115 million for the first full year post-FDA approval, a cash position of US$103 million, and clinical trial progress for rexlemestrocel-L. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly business update.
